cohort: 196 eligible women undergoing elective caesarean section.
finding: One-gram tranexamic acid significantly reduced intraoperative and postpartum blood loss and resulted in significantly better postoperative hemoglobin and PCV levels in women undergoing elective caesarean section compared to a control group receiving only oxytocin.
mod_finding: One-gram tranexamic acid significantly reduced intraoperative and postpartum blood loss during and after elective caesarean sections.
